journal_lines: Petals drifting down without any wind.
Wood pale and close-grained. Smells faintly sweet.
This place makes time feel very long.
A family of rabbits under a fallen log. Worked around them.
Pink petals on the work. A different kind of day.
The wood pale and clean. Works differently from oak.
Cherry trees don't grow as tall. Work is lower to the ground.
The petals drift whether or not there's wind. Something about this place.
Sweet smell in the cut wood.
The bark peels in layers. Useful for other things.
Bees everywhere in the blossoms. Patient work.
A family of deer in the cherry grove. Worked slowly until they moved.
The trees here are not old but they feel that way.
Pink snow. The blossoms falling. Worked through it.
The light here is the pink kind. Unusual and warm.
